(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS Land Acquisition Notices
PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Reference No.: DS/MN/LB/ACQ/4541. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following lands/servitudes which are required for a public purpose. Description of the land or servitude to be acquired: Two allotments of land in total extent of about 0.2072 Hectare, depicted in Preliminary Plan Cadastral Map No. CM 270118 Block No. 07 sheet No. 01, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village of Thiraimadu of No. 173 E Thiraimadu Grama Niladhari Division in Divisional Secretary's Division of Manmunai North, Batticaloa District and bounded as follows: 01. Lot No. 01 Name of land: - ; Present land use : Path; Claimant: Not known; Extent: 0.0762 Hectare North:-; East: -; South: -; West: -; 02. Lot No. 2 Name of land: Thiraimadupoomi; Present land use : Garden contains 3 permanent buildings, 2 part of permanent buildings,

22 Coconut trees 8 - 12 years, 13 Mango trees 8 - 12 years, 3 Jackfruit trees 8 - 12 years and a masonary well and mixed cultivation; Claimant: Not known; Extent: 0.1310 Hectare North: Lot 1; East: Lot 1 and Road (Municipal Council); South: Road (Municipal Council) and Lot No. 14 in PP mada 2047; West: Lot 14 in PP mada 2047, Lot 127 in PP mada 2373 and Lot 1 All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Manmunai North Batticaloa on the 09.07.2025 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 02.07.2025 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. Shivapiriya Vilvaratnam, Divisional Secretary, Manmunai North. EOG 06 - 0024
